lines: Like～I～said, it's Kosaka-sensei, alright? Long time no see, Fuma-kun♪
The beauty with long, fluttering blonde hair smiled playfully.
She was Kosaka Shizuru―an English teacher at our school, Gosha Academy, and a skilled Taimanin who specialized in undercover work.
She was the Taimanin who had gone undercover in Yomihara ahead of us.
Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke-kun too. Thank you for coming, and welcome to Yomihara, the City of Darkness.
Oh! Kosaka-sensei, thank you for your help earlier!
For real, actually!! I thought I was dead for sure～
You're welcome. It was all for my lovely pupils, so don't mention it♪
...Well, there's one troublesome boy here that has yet to come to my class, isn't there?
Shizuru looked at me with a teasing look in her eyes.
Fuma...? Ah, I see. You still never come to Kosaka-sensei's English classes, huh.
Th-, that's not true. I've gone when I'm feeling up to it...  Like once a month.
That was what Shizuru meant when she said "long time no see."
I was still frustrated by having been taken advantage of before, so I still tended to skip Shizuru's classes because of it.
You really are hopeless. But on that point, I'm glad that Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke-kun are always eagerly listening to my lessons.
Hehe! I mean, your classes are super easy to understand, Kosaka-sensei!
Fuma-chan, it's no good to skip classes you know?
Hehehe. See?☆ Your friends are saying so too, Fuma-kun.
Sh-Shut up!! That's got nothing to do with here and now!!
I had a feeling that things would get worse and worse if I let it go.
So I raised my voice and forcefully swept the topic under the rug.
We're in the middle of an undercover mission here!! You said before you didn't need to be called "sensei" during a mission, didn't you?
Yes, of course. Hiding your true identity is an ironclad rule of undercover work―so, no need for you to call me "sensei" this time either.
Huh? But... you just said to call you sensei...
―Hebiko-chan and Shikanosuke-kun, same for you, do you understand?
(This woman, she really throws me off my game...)
Once again, it looked like she had me completely wrapped around her little finger.
As evidenced by her saving us from a tight spot earlier, Shizuru was a first-class Taimanin.
Also known as "Shizuru the Flower," she was a master of a powerful Ninja Art that allowed her to freely control plant life.
(There isn't anyone more reassuring to have as a partner during infiltrations like this.)
I thought this while looking at the blonde bombshell of a Taimanin teacher standing in front of me when suddenly...
With a repulsive face and a muscular body well over two meters tall―it was a High Orc.
Shikanosuke had bumped into a denizen of darkness who had been walking down the street.
Who else is there, you bastard!!? Look, here!! I broke my arm!!!!
Aieee!!? Nothing at all sir! I'm so sorryyyyyy!!!
You think I'm gonna let this slide with a sorry!!? If you're going to apologize then you should do it with some sincerity... Wait a sec.
Now that I get a good look at you, you're a cute-looking bitch, aren't you!!! Hehee, perfect timing...
Whaat!? A guy!!? ...Actually, you're still pretty doable.
You over there, what are you doing!!?
Shizuru and I rushed over to intervene.
At that rate, Shikanosuke was about to faint from his fear.
We should be the ones asking you that. Trying to extort someone with such obvious scam nowadaysー
It's not like you don't know whose territory this district is, right? Did you get a business license from Nomad?
Nomad was a criminal organization that held tremendous power in Tokyo's underground society.
It was only natural to assume that they held a large sphere of influence here in Yomihara as well.
I apologize that this child was careless and bumped into you. But it was just a little scrape, wasn't it?
It might be better for all of us to avoid petty squabbles within Nomad's territory, don't you think?
He must have concluded that he couldn't easily extort us.
The denizen of darkness clicked his tongue in annoyance and left.
He's gone huh... But damn, that's some welcome after we've just arrived.
He said Shikanosuke had bumped into him, but he had clearly been the one to approach first.
It must've been a scheme from the beginning where he'd place blame on Shikanosuke and then blackmail us for money.
W-What's with this city?! It's way too scary...!!!
Calm down, Shikanosuke-kun. In this city, you'll paint a target on your back if you show weakness. Act like you own the place.
Rather, it was probably very lucky that we weren't attacked on the spot.
Located 300 meters below the surface of Tokyo, the City of Darkness: Yomihara.
We stood in a plaza close to the entrance, with streets branching out to other areas of the city.
The nearby street stalls and stands were lined with shady-looking black-market goods, and the people passing by were all demons or scary-looking gangsters.
Richly colored neon lights illuminated everything, and it truly gave the impression of an underground red light district.
Large drops of "rain" were pouring down on the plaza. Passersby rushed under the eaves of the buildings.
That's the "rain"of Yomihara. The rain from the surface travels through the earth until it gets here.
Huh, so this is it... If I remember right this should be rain that fell above ground 10 to 15 years ago, right?
I had read about it in a book but this was my first time seeing it myself.
That's right. It has a bit of charm to it, doesn't it? ...Anyway, let's not spend any longer chatting in it though.
Let's head for the hideout. I'll explain the details of the mission once we're there.
Yeah. It's too cold to be hanging around like this.
Understood. ーHey, Shikanosuke. We're gonna pick up the pace here but try not to get lost. ...Wait, Shikanosuke?
At some point, Shikanosuke had completely vanished from my side.
My eyes darted all around as I looked and―
Hahaha, what a haul today!! This brat will get us some good money!
It was the High Orc that Shikanosuke had bumped into earlier and a group that seemed like his comrades.
Amidst the bustling crowd of people trying to take shelter from the passing rain, Shikanosuke was being taken away, his mouth covered.
Mnggh... buah!!! Aiee!! Not goood!! Fuma help meeeeeee!!!
Ah, damn brat!!? I said keep quiet!!
Mwahaha, that's better. ...Anyway, what do you think? Just the kind of brat you like, eh boss?
He covered Shikanosuke's mouth again and called out to the High Orc at the front of the group who seemed to be their leader.
Yeah, gehehe... I love me a nice tight-assed little bitch like this.
Ah. Err... no, boss. Apparently, it's a guy.
Whaat!? A guyyyyyy!? You idiot, I told you to bring me girls! Hold up.......... He's doable.
The boss carefully examined Shikanosuke's face and body and then nodded gravely.
That's not good!! And in more ways than one for Shikanosuke!!
It seemed he had been kidnapped during the confusion of the passing rain shower.
I can't believe they'd go after Shikanosuke-kun when there are two beautiful ladies right here...!?
I'm shocked... What a freaky bunch!!!
What are you shocked for!!? We're going after them!
